briefing: Markets slipped modestly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.9% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%. That counts as a neutral session, not a clear risk-off signal. Cash is $445.88, just under the $500 minimum for a new buy, so I am holding all 7 positions and not forcing a trade. The automatic stop-losses and profit targets stay in place, and I will put cash to work on the next clear risk-on day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor keeps on hand on purpose so they can buy when a good opportunity comes. Today the portfolio's cash was slightly below the minimum for a new trade and the market was only mildly down. Waiting for a strong up day before buying is a disciplined choice, not a missed chance.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」是指投資者刻意保留的現金，用來在好機會出現時買入。今日組合的現金略低於新開倉的最低門檻，市場亦只是輕微下跌。等待明確的強勢上升日才入市是有紀律的選擇，並非錯失機會。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted lower today. The tech-heavy NASDAQ fell 0.9%, more than the 0.4% drop in the broader S&P 500, which suggests investors were trimming growth and tech names rather than leaving the market. Large chip and AI-infrastructure stocks such as NVDA, AMD and SMCI are trading below their 20-day averages, which points to continued rotation out of crowded semiconductor trades. No news headlines came with today's data, so this explanation rests only on price action, not on a specific catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日小幅走低，以科技股為主的納指跌0.9%，跌幅大於標普500的0.4%，反映資金主要是減持成長股與科技股，並非全面撤離市場。NVDA、AMD、SMCI等大型晶片及AI基建股價格仍低於20日均線，顯示資金持續從擁擠的半導體交易中輪動流出。今日數據並未附帶新聞標題，以上解讀僅根據價格走勢，並無特定消息催化。
